## Triage Complete

**Verdict: true issue, but (a) SPEC-side / low severity / high confidence — not a code defect.**

The evidence:

| Aspect | Finding |
|---|---|
| **Code** | `pool_id(staked_sui) { staked_sui.pool_id }` — a trivial field projection. Correctness is guaranteed by the Move type system; **no implementation bug is possible** → definitively (a), not (b). |
| **Spec gap (real?)** | Yes, factually: `pool_id_spec` has no `ensures`, so it verifies only (trivial) abort-freedom. |
| **Impact (overstated?)** | Yes. This is the **codebase-wide convention** — every trivial accessor in the file (`stake_activation_epoch_spec`, `staked_sui_amount_spec`, `sui_balance_spec`, etc.) is an `ensures`-free `no_opaque` registration spec. |
